what_happened: Style/layout 6 (over-the-range microwave like s25 and success s19; the bowl starts on the counter right of a double sink). Stage 0: garlic grasped at 128, released into the large wooden bowl at 224 (0.06 m from the centre), stage 0 at 226. Stage 1: the bowl was grasped by its rim at 302 and lifted only 0.16 m. Instead of carrying it, the arm twisted the bowl up onto its edge over the sink (tipped from 404, up to 130 deg; the wrist camera turns until it sees the robot's own base, 404-432). It held the bowl standing on edge over/in the sink 440-560; the garlic fell out into the left sink basin at ~560 (stage 0 undone for good). The policy kept holding and pushing the near-vertical bowl around in the sink for ~700 more steps (holds 311-659, 671-745, 750-786, 793-end), re-oriented it at ~1248 (close event 1248, lift 0.6 m), and only at ~1340-1400 turned toward the microwave with the empty bowl. The bowl was still held 0.85 m from the microwave at the timeout. No microwave contact.
causal_chain: rim grasp at 302 followed by a twist that stands the bowl on edge (404) -> garlic spills into the sink at ~560 -> ~700 steps of fumbling with the upright bowl in the sink -> reoriented at 1248 and heads for the microwave with an empty bowl at ~1340 -> timeout (1400) before the bowl is placed
self_recovery: it eventually re-grasped and reoriented the bowl (1248) and headed for the microwave, but never retrieved the garlic.
official_criterion_notes: Stage 0 stayed 'complete' (with one-step blips) 404-560 while the bowl was tipped up to 130 deg and standing on edge: check_obj_in_receptacle only needs contact plus horizontal centre distance, with no upright check on the bowl.

packet_facts: vegetable hold 135-224 lift 0.34; at_target until 560; end in sink (z 0.745)
no microwave contacts; bowl ends 0.85 m from the interior

uncertain_about: Why the arm twisted the bowl right after grasping (possibly a bad rim grasp near the sink wall); the bowl's orientation 440-1240 is partly occluded by the arm.
